title: 第六十三章 伊布四兄弟 T第六十二章 史顿镇和小智的相遇
content_zh:
“伊布？”
就在林萧尴尬时，一个小男孩，打开大门，看到娜姿怀里的伊布，惊呼道。
“布伊~~”看到小男孩，伊布高兴的叫了一声，欢快的从娜姿怀里跳下，跑到小男孩身旁，用头亲昵的磨蹭他。
看伊布的行为就能知道，小男孩就是伊布的主人，太一，不过他为什么要将伊布丢在森林里？
还没有等林萧说话，芽衣就冲了上来，鼓着包子脸，不满的太一说道：“你是怎么当训练家的？不知道训练家要爱护自己的小精灵吗？你将它丢到森林里，不让它回来，你知道伊布用多伤心吗？”
面对芽衣的叱喝，小男孩委屈的撅起小嘴，眼里噙满泪水，大声反驳：“你们为什么要将它带回来？人家本想过一段时间久将伊布接回来的，因为现在家里在举办进化派对，哥哥们一定会让伊布选择进化的。”
小男孩越说越伤心，微微抽泣起来，弄得林萧一行人一头雾水。
“因为不想看到哥哥们的争斗，我选择把伊布藏起来，等过了进化派代再接回来的......我不想让伊布进化.....不想看到哥哥们为了伊布的进化型而争闹.....呜呜呜.....”
这也太孩子气了吧，怎么说着说着就哭起来了。
这时，太一家的庄园里走出三个人，三人神别分别带着火精灵、水精灵、和雷精灵，看样子就是太一所说的三个哥哥。
其中带着火精灵的头发男子弯下腰，搂住太一柔声道：“哥哥们只是希望太一让伊布进化，那样实力会强上很多，但我们并没有强迫你太一。”
“是啊，”一旁带着水精灵的蓝发男子说道：“我们伊布四兄弟可是很团结的，怎么会因为伊布的进化型而吵闹呢。太一，如果你不愿意让伊布进化和哥哥们说就可以，干嘛把伊布藏起来，害我们担心一场。”
“哥哥.....”太一看着三位微笑点头的哥哥，再也忍不住放声嗷嗷大哭起来。
在三位哥哥的安慰下，太一好不容易忍住眼泪，破涕为笑，鞠躬感谢道：“谢谢你们讲伊布带回来，如果可以的话，请到我家参加进化派对吧。”
小孩子就是单纯，爆发的容易，收起来也快......
林萧等人答应的太一的邀请，参加太一家举办的进化派对，视乎这是请来的客人都能在伊布四兄弟这里免费得到进化石让小精灵进化。
偌大的庄园占地至少几十亩，难道挖进化石的人都这么富有？看着眼前豪华的庄园，林萧心里不禁期待起来，不知道自己还在施工中的房子修建好以后会是什么样子。
“等等.....”太一的大哥，就是红发男子突然叫住大家，转过身不停的打量芽衣，赤，裸，裸的眼神看的芽衣心里发毛。
微微朝林萧身后躲去，芽衣露出一个小脑袋，“请问你有什么事？”
自己的妞被别人盯着看，林萧立刻就不爽了，板起脸，不爽道：“请问你盯着我女朋友不放，是什么意思？”小智三人一副见到小怪兽的模样，就算你喜欢芽衣也不用在别人男朋友面前这样吧......

发现自己的作法很失礼，红发男子尴尬一笑，用手在头上敲了几下，朝芽衣鞠躬歉意道：“对不起，美丽的小姐，我并没有那种意思，我只是在你身上闻到一股伊布的味道，所以想问你是不是有伊布.....造成大家的误解我很抱歉！”
原来是这样，听了红发男子的解释，芽衣松了口气，拍拍自己饱，满的小胸，脯，微微一笑，说道：“我确实有三只伊布，在野生原野区收服的。”
红发男子微微一笑，说道：“为了表示我的歉意，如果你想让伊布进化我会为你免费提供进化石的。”
“不要.....”芽衣坚决的使劲摇头，“我想让伊布进化成太阳精灵.冰精灵和叶精灵。”
“伊布还有其他的进化型？”众人瞪着打眼，惊愕道。伊布的其他几种进化型虽然不是什么秘密，但是知道的训练家确实不多，尤其是在关东。
敲敲的拉下林萧的衣服，芽衣示意林萧来说。
又是我？林萧的嘴角微微抽搐了一下，向众人说伊布其他几种进化型，进化的条件。
良久，太一的三位哥哥，你看我，我看你，最后苦笑道：“亏我们自认为是最了解伊布的人，竟然连伊布还有其他的进化型都不知道......看来我们的阅历还是太少。”
“这点你们不必介怀，因为伊布的其他进化型，主要存在神奥地区，不清楚也是很正常的。”
看着纠结不堪的三人，林萧只好做起和事老，解释道。
谁知这三兄弟异口同声道：“不不不.....这不是地区的问题，而是我们的知识范围太小。”
真不愧为三兄弟，说话都这么默契。
良久，红发男子似乎下了什么决定，对三位弟弟说道：“我打算过了进化派对就出去旅行，家里就要麻烦你们照看了。”
“凭什么？”红发男子的话刚落音，蓝发男子就开始抗议，“我也要出去旅行，看家的任务还是交给老三比较好。”
身为老三的黄发男子，翻了个白眼，吹了个口哨，“既然大家都想出去旅行，那就别推了，干脆我们伊布四兄弟一起出去好了，不是说兄弟同心其利断金吗？把小弟一个人放在家里我不放心。”
“嗯....有道理...”老大和老二摸着下巴点点头。
最后在老大的拍板下，伊布四兄弟决定关闭家里的进化石商场，一起出去旅行，可怜的老幺太一，脸发言的权利都没有，自己的命运就被三位哥哥定下。
参加完伊布四兄弟的进化派对之后，林萧等人选择了离开，其中四兄弟中的老大临行前松了林萧一套进化石，林萧没有推辞，爽朗的收下了。
至于小智三人.....不知被钱迷昏了还是怎么说，竟然要留下来挖进化石！！！又能赚钱，又能锻炼身体的劳动，是多么的高尚......

content_en:
"Ibrahimovic?"
Just when Lin Xiao was embarrassed, a little boy opened the door and exclaimed when he saw Ibrahimovic in Nazi's arms.
"Bui~~" Seeing the little boy, Ibrahimovic screamed happily, happily jumped out of Nazi's arms, ran to the little boy, and rubbed his head affectionately against him.
You can tell from Ibrahimovic's behavior that the little boy is Ibrahimovic's master, Taichi, but why did he leave Ibrahimovic in the forest?
Before Lin Xiao could say anything, Mei Yi rushed up, with a puffed-up face, and a dissatisfied Taiyi said: "How did you become a trainer? Don't you know that trainers should take care of their own elf? You threw it into the forest and didn't let it come back. Do you know how sad Ibrahimovic is?"
Facing Mei's scolding, the little boy pouted in grievance, with tears in his eyes, and retorted loudly: "Why did you bring it back? I had wanted to bring Ibrahimovic back for a long time, because there is an evolution party at home, and my brothers will definitely let Ibrahimovic choose to evolve."
The little boy became more and more sad as he talked, sobbing slightly, leaving Lin Xiao and his group confused.
"Because I didn't want to see my brothers fight, I chose to hide Eevee and bring him back after the evolutionary generation... I didn't want Eevee to evolve... I didn't want to see my brothers fighting over Eevee's evolved form... wu wu wu..."
This is too childish, why did I start crying as I spoke.
At this time, three people walked out of the manor of Taiyi's family. The three gods were carrying fire elves, water elves, and thunder elves respectively. It seemed that they were the three brothers Taiyi mentioned.
Among them, the man with fire elf hair bent down, hugged Taiyi and said softly: "Brothers just hope that Taiyi will let Ibrahimovic evolve, so that the strength will be much stronger, but we are not forcing you Taiyi."
"Yes," said the blue-haired man with the water elf on the side: "We, the four Eevee brothers, are very united. Why are we so noisy because of Ievee's evolved form? Taiyi, if you don't want Ievee to evolve, just tell your brothers. Why hide Eevee and make us worry?"
"Brother..." Taiyi looked at the three brothers who were smiling and nodding, and couldn't help but burst into tears.
Under the comfort of his three brothers, Taiyi finally held back his tears, smiled through his tears, bowed and thanked him: "Thank you for bringing Ibrahimovic back. If you can, please come to my house to attend the evolution party."
Children are innocent, they can break out easily and put it away quickly...
Lin Xiao and others agreed to Taiyi's invitation to attend the evolution party held by Taiyi's family. It seemed that all the invited guests could get evolution stones for free from the four Ibrahimovic brothers to evolve the elves.
The huge manor covers an area of ​​at least dozens of acres. Are the people who dig up the fossils so rich? Looking at the luxurious manor in front of him, Lin Xiao couldn't help but look forward to it. He didn't know what his house, which was still under construction, would look like after it was completed.
"Wait..." Taiyi's eldest brother, the red-haired man, suddenly stopped everyone, turned around and kept looking at Mei Yi. The naked, naked, naked look in his eyes made Mei Yi feel scared.
Weiwei hid behind Lin Xiao, Yayi revealed a small head, "What can I do for you?"
Lin Xiao immediately became upset when his girl was stared at by others. He put on a straight face and said unhappily: "Excuse me, what do you mean by staring at my girlfriend?" Xiaozhi and the other three looked like they were seeing little monsters. Even if you like Mei, you don't have to do this in front of other people's boyfriends...
Realizing that what he did was very rude, the red-haired man smiled awkwardly, hit his head a few times with his hand, bowed to Mei Yi and apologized: "I'm sorry, beautiful lady, I didn't mean that, I just smelled an Eevee on you, so I wanted to ask you if you have Eevee... This caused everyoneI'm sorry for the misunderstanding! "
So that was it. After hearing the red-haired man’s explanation, Mei Yi breathed a sigh of relief, patted her full breasts, smiled slightly, and said, “I do have three Eevee, which I tamed in the wild wilderness area. "
The red-haired man smiled slightly and said: "To express my apology, if you want Ibrahimovic to evolve, I will provide you with evolution stones for free. "
"No..." Mei shook her head firmly, "I want Ibrahimovic to evolve into a sun elf, an ice elf and a leaf elf. "
"Ibrahimovic has other evolved forms? "Everyone stared and said in shock. Although Ibrahimovic's other evolved forms are not a secret, not many trainers know about them, especially in Kanto.
Knocking down Lin Xiao's clothes, Yayi motioned to Lin Xiao to speak.
Me again? The corner of Lin Xiao's mouth twitched slightly, and he told everyone about Ibrahimovic's other evolutionary types and the conditions for evolution.
For a long time, Taiyi's three brothers looked at me, and I looked at you, and finally said with a wry smile: "We think we know Ibrahimovic best, but we don't even know about Ibrahimovic and other evolved forms... It seems that our experience is still too little. "
“You don’t have to worry about this, because the other evolved forms of Eevee mainly exist in the Sinnoh region, so it’s normal to be unclear about them. "
Looking at the entangled three people, Lin Xiao had no choice but to make peace and explained.
Unexpectedly, the three brothers said in unison: "No, no, no... This is not a problem of the region, but the scope of our knowledge is too small. "
We are truly worthy of being three brothers, they all speak with such tacit understanding.
After a long time, the red-haired man seemed to have made a decision, and said to his three brothers: "I plan to go on a trip after the evolution party, and my family will trouble you to take care of it. "
"Why? "As soon as the red-haired man finished speaking, the blue-haired man began to protest, "I also want to go on a trip. It's better to leave the housekeeping task to the third child. "
The middle-aged man with yellow hair rolled his eyes and whistled, "Since everyone wants to go on a trip, let's stop pushing it. Let's go out together as the four Ibrahimovic brothers. Isn't it said that brothers who work together can make a difference?" I don't feel comfortable leaving my little brother alone at home. "
"Hmm...that makes sense..." The eldest and second eldest men touched their chins and nodded.
Finally, under the boss's approval, the four Ibrahimovic brothers decided to close their family's Evolution Stone Mall and go on a trip together. Poor Taiyi, the youngest, had no right to speak, so his fate was decided by the three brothers.
After attending the evolution party of the four Ibrahimovic brothers, Lin Xiao and others chose to leave. The eldest of the four brothers gave Lin Xiao a set of evolution stones before leaving. Lin Xiao accepted it happily without refusing.
As for Xiaozhi and the other three... I don't know if they were stunned by the money or something, but they actually wanted to stay and dig for evolution stones! ! ! How noble is the labor that can make money and exercise the body at the same time...
